title: Logo misuse
slide_intent: Teach reviewers to identify which aspect of a signature has changed. Side-by-side mistakes make specific discrepancies easier to diagnose.
strategic_value: Slack can keep the mark consistent by showing the effect of altering color, type, geometry and image treatment.
demonstration: Ten rows pair a short instruction with an altered logo. Examples include cropping, transparency, palette changes, distorted proportions, shadows and a rotated component.
practical_value: Identify the change in a proposed file by matching it to the examples, then return to the supplied lockup artwork.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Place the small bold title at upper left above a horizontal rule spanning the page.

content_islands.name: Changes to the signature
content_islands.spec: Place five instructions on a pale vertical strip at left and align a corresponding altered signature beside each.

content_islands.name: Distortion and treatment
content_islands.spec: Repeat the five-row arrangement in the right half. Pair each instruction with its own specimen so a reviewer can isolate the change.

content_islands.name: Running footer
content_islands.spec: Below a thin rule at the foot, align the folio, book title and Design elements section label.
